target_claim.statement: Expression features are exploratorily associated with mCherry.log.slope in the observed Live-seq cells.

search_fingerprint.biological_system: Live-seq cells with paired expression and mCherry.log.slope-like phenotype measurements
search_fingerprint.perturbation_condition: observational phenotype variation; no identified randomized intervention
search_fingerprint.phenotype_outcome: mCherry.log.slope or a documented biologically comparable dynamic phenotype
search_fingerprint.assay: single-cell transcriptomic measurement paired with live-cell phenotyping
search_fingerprint.time_structure: cell collection across documented independent biological collection events
search_fingerprint.required_biological_unit: independently collected biological material with a defensible grouping key
acceptable_substitutions: a documented comparable dynamic reporter phenotype
a compatible single-cell assay with raw or sufficiently processed data
unacceptable_substitutions: alternate sequencing runs or flow cells from exp8
the same donor, clone, culture, extraction event, or pooled library material

sources_searched.query_or_scope: paired live-cell phenotype and single-cell expression studies compatible with the target claim
candidate raw-data provenance and shared BioProject/sample identifiers

sources_searched.source: EMBL-EBI ArrayExpress and Single Cell Expression Atlas
sources_searched.query_or_scope: independent compatible cellular systems and assay records

sources_searched.source: article citations, supplements, and related-record links
sources_searched.query_or_scope: conceptual and direct replication candidates plus shared-source leakage

prespecified_test.primary_endpoint: Reproduction of the prespecified directional association between expression-derived signal and the compatible dynamic phenotype on independent biological units.
prespecified_test.expected_direction: same prespecified direction as the target exploratory result
prespecified_test.biological_grouping_key: candidate-specific independently collected biological source or collection event
exclusion_criteria: plate, library, lane, or sequencing run used as the biological grouping key
target data reprocessing or derivative datasets
condition inseparable from incompatible batch structure
prespecified_test.success_criteria: A prespecified analysis on an independently verified compatible dataset reproduces the directional result with robustness to documented biological grouping and major candidate confounders.

next_valid_action: Execute the repository search, classify every candidate for biological-source independence, and accept none until provenance and experimental units are verified.

safety_status.notes: No public candidate has yet been verified or analysed; physical experiments are outside this contract.
